newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanese hunter killed by Israeli soldiers.
newsitem.headline: Lebanese hunter killed by Israeli soldiers.

text.p: A Lebanese hunter was killed on Saturday when Israeli soldiers in Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone mistook hunters for Moslem guerrillas and opened fire, Israeli security sources said.
Another hunter and an Israeli soldier were wounded in the incident near the town of Dibl in the western sector of the zone at 5:00 pm local time (1400 GMT).
The sources said the Israeli soldier was wounded when the hunters returned fire.
Israeli troops occupy a 15-km (nine mile)-wide zone in south Lebanon. Hizbollah (Party of God) guerrillas often attack the occupation troops in bid to oust them from Lebanon.
